proposals.text:
Understood — I will proceed with ordering replacement credit cards for both credit accounts and freezing the active debit card on each of your three checking accounts, but I need one quick confirmation before I act.

1) Shipping address: I have 7845 Maple Street, Denver, CO 80202 on file for you. Should I ship the replacement credit cards to that address? (yes / no — if no, please provide the correct secure shipping address)

2) Optional: Would you like us to also block ATM withdrawals on those frozen debit cards while they’re frozen? (yes / no)

If you confirm the address (and tell me about ATM blocks if you want them), I’ll place the replacement orders and freeze the three active debit cards immediately. I will then confirm each action and the last‑4 digits for the replacement cards when available.
